items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: well all of those names are completely strange to me

ctx.x: I don't remember I think he just went up there and was having a hard time for a while you know he was just scuffling around New York but Cordillo told me about it he's here now he was a clarinet player in the black section
well all of those names are completely strange to me I don't know
sometimes things turn up that way what about Troy Floyd this colored band
